archetypes.name: dyn-gate-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Approval-gate prose is normative control-flow surface despite density-only edits.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the approval-gates.md diff for unintended changes to Gate A, Gate B, and Gate C routing. Pay special attention to option-set behavior for See full plan, Other, --per-round-approval, and --skip-approve. Confirm commands, question text, KV names, and file paths still describe the same contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-structural-pins
archetypes.rationale: Exact grep-pinned literals and anti-halt prose must survive prose compression.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the structural-test frozen substrings remain byte-identical in the changed file. Verify Gate B resume-idempotency lines, settle dispatch items 1 and 2, the auto-apply breadcrumb, loop-mode resume command, and Gate C Approve is NOT a halt paragraph. Look for nearby prose that weakens those pinned contracts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
